audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart on disk gives Akshan levels 1-3 and Skill from 4-5 onward; the mirror audit and the packet chart both put level 1 at Skill and levels 4-5, 6 and first item with Akshan.
audit.why: Karma's only clean stage is level 1 before Heroic Swing is learned; from 4 onward she cannot shove a mobile ranged skirmisher off the wave, and Heroic Swing (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s) breaks the tether by leaving line of sight.
audit.corrected: Skill / Akshan / Akshan / Akshan / Akshan / Akshan / Skill, proposed as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why says only 'his spike is the danger window' without naming it, and the ratings at 6 and first item did not follow the mirror's re-tuning.
audit.why: Mantra is available from level 1 so Karma has no level-6 spike at all, while Going Rogue camouflage plus the Scoundrel revive is Akshan's map spike.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item rated 3/10 for Karma (mirror rated them 7/10 for Akshan); 2+ items 5/10 both sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Focused Resolve reveals Akshan out of Going Rogue camouflage — the single answer to his roam and pick pattern.
audit.why: Karma's W deals damage and reveals the target; Going Rogue is camouflage, so the reveal breaks it.
audit.corrected: Tether the shimmer: Focused Resolve reveals him out of Going Rogue, and without Heroic Swing up his thin frame cannot escape the root.

audit.why: The kit-derived 'terrain' flag on Going Rogue misfires — Riot's description makes it camouflage plus move speed, not terrain creation. Text already avoids claiming terrain creation.
sources: kit file description vs derived flag

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Avengerang plus stacked Dirty Fighting autos chip faster than you refund Mantra — his window opens.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Heroic Swing (15s at rank 3) breaks your tether by leaving line of sight, so every trade ends on his terms.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Heroic Swing — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: You can't shove a mobile ranged skirmisher off the wave — he kites Inner Flame with the swing and re-pokes with Avengerang.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Mantra was up at 1, so 6 is flat for you; Going Rogue camouflage and the revive hand him the map instead.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: Your AP spike sharpens the RQ chunk, but Heroic Swing still breaks the root on every all-in.

edits.before: Your R is just a re-empower you already had from level 1, but his W Going Rogue camouflage near terrain and scoundrel revive let him commit and roam without fearing your chip.
edits.after: Your R is just a re-empower you already had from level 1, but Going Rogue camouflage and scoundrel revive let him roam freely — Focused Resolve reveals him, so tether him as he closes.

edits.before: Punish the moment his Heroic Swing is down — without it his thin frame has no way out of your W tether's root
edits.after: Focused Resolve reveals him out of Going Rogue — tether the shimmer and his thin frame has no way out of the root

notes: Packet suspectNames for 'Heroic Swing' are FALSE POSITIVES — it is Akshan's real E.
